mn8:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn8:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahācundo sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahācundo Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn8:3.1: Yā imā bhante anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti
mn8:3.3: ādim-eva nu kho bhante bhikkhuno manasikaroto evam-etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam-etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hotīti.
mn8:3.4: Yā imā Cunda anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti
mn8:3.6: yattha c' etā diṭṭhiyo uppajjanti yattha ca anusenti yattha ca samudācaranti, taṃ: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham-asmi, na meso attā ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato evam-etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam-etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hoti.
mn8:4.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya;
mn8:4.4: Na kho pan' ete Cunda ariyassa vinaye sallekhā vuccanti,
mn8:4.5: diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārā ete ariyassa vinaye vuccanti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn8:5.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya;
mn8:6.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca vihareyya sato ca sampajāno sukhañ-ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeyya yan-taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya;
mn8:7.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya;
mn8:7.4: Na kho pan' ete Cunda ariyassa vinaye sallekhā vuccanti
mn8:8.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthagamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyya;
mn8:8.4: Na kho pan' ete Cunda ariyassa vinaye sallekhā vuccanti,

mn8:9.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ Cunda vijjati yaṃ idh' ekacco bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇan-ti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyya;

mn8:17.1: Iti kho Cunda desito mayā sallekhapariyāyo, desito cittuppādapariyāyo, desito parikkamanapariyāyo, desito uparibhāvapariyāyo, desito parinibbānapariyāyo.
mn8:17.2: Yaṃ kho Cunda satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
mn8:17.3: Etāni Cunda rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha Cunda, mā pamādattha, ma pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha, ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī ti.
mn8:17.5: Attamano āyasmā Mahācundo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 9.
